title: NeMo-DCR: Bit-Exact Delta-Compressed Refit for Scalable Agentic RL at Trillion-Parameter Scale

paragraphs.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) disaggregates training from rollout, so each policy update must reach the rollout clusters before the next batch. Transferring a full 1T checkpoint for such weight synchronization (refit) takes 87.5 min between two AWS regions. Measurements of BF16 training show that about 1% of weights change their stored values per step. Recent systems exploit this sparsity but fall short on placement, exactness, or efficiency: they reimplement placement rules, assemble full tensors, rebuild values arithmetically, or use a cross-cluster collective, and none fully recovers from mid-refit failures. We present NeMo-DCR (Delta-Compressed Refit), which sends only changes yet is bit-exact: receivers obtain the same parameter and buffer bits as a dense refit. For placement, fixed affine mappings project changes from training shards into the checkpoint's canonical coordinates, residual conversion covers the other changes, and the serving runtime's native loader places all changes in receiver storage. For exactness, compressible XOR masks carry affine changes whose projection and loader preserve stored bits, and overwrites carry the others. Receivers apply both in place, retries overwrite partial writes, and a joint commit binds the policy to the baseline for the next delta. For efficiency, object storage or a relay tree streams payloads during delta construction, without a cross-cluster collective. Even at 3% and 5% change rates, NeMo-DCR refits of 30B-1T models are 12-40$\times$ faster than a transport-only full-checkpoint reference. A 1T relay-tree refit at 3% takes 150 s instead of 87.5 min, making refits practical for cross-cluster agentic RL at trillion-parameter scale.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）将训练与执行过程分离，因此每次策略更新都必须在下一批数据到来前到达执行集群。 在两个 AWS 区域之间传输完整的 1T 检查点以实现此类权重同步（重新拟合）需要 87.5 分钟。 BF16 训练的测量结果表明，每一步约有 1% 的权重会改变其存储值。 近期系统虽然利用了这种稀疏性，但在部署位置、精确性或效率方面仍存在不足：它们重新实现了部署规则、组装了完整张量、通过算术方式重建数值，或使用了跨集群集体操作，但没有任何一种方法能完全恢复中途重新拟合失败的情况。 我们提出了 NeMo-DCR（Delta-Compressed Refit），它仅传输变化部分且保持位级精确：接收方能够获得与密集重新拟合相同的参数和缓冲位。 在部署位置方面，固定的仿射映射将训练分片中的变化投影到检查点的标准坐标中，残差转换覆盖其余变化，而服务运行时的原生加载器将所有变化放置到接收方的存储中。 在精确性方面，可压缩的 XOR 掩码携带仿射变化的投影和加载器能够保留存储位，而覆盖操作则处理其余变化。 接收方会原地应用这两种操作，重试机制会覆盖部分写入，而联合提交则将策略与基线绑定用于下一个增量更新。 在效率方面，对象存储或中继树可在增量构建期间流式传输负载，无需跨集群集体操作。 即使变化率高达 3% 和 5%，NeMo-DCR 对 30B-1T 模型的重新拟合速度也比仅传输完整检查点的参考方法快 12-40 倍。 在 3% 的变化率下，使用中继树的 1T 重新拟合仅需 150 秒，而非 87.5 分钟，这使得万亿参数规模的跨集群智能体强化学习的重新拟合成为现实。
